candidate_sentence_map.S1: AB Amber Grid reported a significant improvement in financial performance for the three-month period ended 31 March 2026.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Revenue increased by 58% to EUR 32,821 thousand, compared to EUR 20,763 thousand in the same period of 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: This growth was primarily driven by a 35% increase in the volume of natural gas transmitted and higher transmission prices set for 2026.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Conversely, revenue from system balancing products decreased by 99% to EUR 24 thousand, a change attributed to a new transit agreement with Kaliningrad that significantly reduced the need for balancing gas.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Operating expenses excluding depreciation, impairment, and write-offs decreased by 19% to EUR 9,570 thousand, largely due to a 68% drop in natural gas costs.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Purchases of natural gas and related services fell to EUR 1,477 thousand from EUR 4,622 thousand in the prior year period.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Consequently, EBITDA surged to EUR 23,304 thousand, up from EUR 8,918 thousand in 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Operating profit (EBIT) also improved substantially, reaching EUR 19,627 thousand compared to EUR 5,185 thousand in the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Net profit for the quarter was EUR 15,763 thousand, a marked increase from EUR 4,239 thousand in 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Earnings per share rose to EUR 0.09 from EUR 0.02.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: The company’s adjusted EBITDA was EUR 8,285 thousand, reflecting temporary regulatory differences.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: On the balance sheet, total assets stood at EUR 324,064 thousand, while total equity increased to EUR 182,039 thousand from EUR 166,276 thousand at the end of 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Net debt increased to EUR 106,610 thousand from EUR 76,052 thousand in the prior year period, influenced by changes in borrowings.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: The company reclassified certain long-term borrowings to current liabilities in late 2025 due to covenant issues, but these were reclassified back to non-current in February 2026 following a loan transfer agreement with EPSO-G.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Cash and cash equivalents decreased to EUR 832 thousand from EUR 1,942 thousand at year-end 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: The company continues to manage a legal dispute regarding guarantee funds for the GIPL pipeline, with a provision of EUR 5,815 thousand recognized for potential repayment.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: In April 2026, the General Meeting of Shareholders approved a dividend distribution of EUR 9,989 thousand.
